ideas.pitch: An automated local static analysis tool tailored for solo developers to catch edge cases, race conditions, and anti-patterns before final submission.

ideas.problem_statement: Codathon 1.0 Finals: Solo participants build, deploy, and submit a working prototype within the given timeline.
